text:
I'm working on Zustri (https://zustri.com), booking and scheduling for therapists and salons. My girlfriend is a therapist and didn't like any of the booking/scheduling software she tried, so I built her one.

I finished the basics a long while ago. Since then I've added an AI agent, a public booking page, and support for multiple staff. Hopefully, I'm launching soon. Currently finishing final touches, gathering feedback and trying to figure out how to market this
